overall: AG found the committee violated the Open Meeting Law by approving insufficiently detailed minutes for three superintendent-hiring meetings, but declined to find the violation intentional; the minutes were already amended, so no further remedy beyond compliance and member training.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee approved insufficiently detailed minutes for three meetings in December 2020 about hiring a new superintendent, including finalist interviews.
allegations.key_passage: find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by approving insufficiently detailed minutes for the meetings in question.

allegations.summary: Complainant urged that the minutes violation was intentional; the AG considered whether the committee knowingly violated the Law.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore decline to find that the violation was intentional.

remedy: We order the Committee's immediate and future compliance with the Law.
We also order each Committee member to review the Attorney General's Open Meeting Law training video on meeting minutes.
Each member shall certify to our office that they have done so within sixty (60) days of receipt of this letter.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee's immediate and future compliance with the Law.
